integrity: Complete finite 16-by-81 enumeration and independent matching characterization with a standalone standard-library executable, plus algebraic probability reductions. Originality is conditional on accessible comparison literature; independent scientific validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two workers and two unit-capacity firms; independent identically distributed original weak orders; all potential partners acceptable; ex ante report-independent tie-refinement distributions; no claims for heterogeneous/larger markets or strategyproofness.
title: Sharp tie-breaking risk and optimal common priorities in a two-by-two matching market
